q: Do I need to be good at coding?
a: As long as you give it your best and ship a quality project. Effort beats raw skill! Just make sure what you ship actually works.

q: Can I apply more than once?
a: Double Dip is not allowed (yet), but feel free to submit a new project anytime.

q: What if I don't finish in time?
a: Life happens! If you don't finish in time, reach out on Slack and we'll figure something out. The deadline is flexible if you ask nicely.
